name: Securities Return Criteria 1
definition: Return criteria for information to be returned in the report deriving from a query about securities reference data.

ISOSecurityShortName.name: ISO Security Short Name
ISOSecurityShortName.definition: Short name of the security expressed as ISO 18773/18774.

ClassificationFinancialInstrument.name: Classification Financial Instrument
ClassificationFinancialInstrument.definition: Classification type of the financial instrument, as per the ISO Classification of Financial Instrument (CFI) codification, for example, common share with voting rights, fully paid, or registered.

MaturityDate.name: Maturity Date
MaturityDate.definition: Planned final repayment date at the time of issuance.

IssueDate.name: Issue Date
IssueDate.definition: Date/time at which the security was made available.

IssueCurrency.name: Issue Currency
IssueCurrency.definition: Currency in which a security is issued or redenominated.

CountryOfIssue.name: Country Of Issue
CountryOfIssue.definition: Primary market or country where a security is issued by the issuer or its agent.

SecurityStatus.name: Security Status
SecurityStatus.definition: Specifies the status of the security within its lifecycle.

MinimumDenomination.name: Minimum Denomination
MinimumDenomination.definition: Indicates the minimum quantity (unit or nominal) of a security.

MinimumMultipleQuantity.name: Minimum Multiple Quantity
MinimumMultipleQuantity.definition: Minimum multiple quantity (unit or nominal) of securities.

DeviatingSettlementUnit.name: Deviating Settlement Unit
DeviatingSettlementUnit.definition: Minimum quantity of securities that can be purchased without incurring a larger fee. For example, if the round lot size is 100 and the trade is for 125 shares, then 100 will be processed without a fee and the remaining 25 will incur a service fee for being an odd lot size.
